name: Neira
source:
Despite her young age, she is one of the wisest rulers in the Kingdom of Temporia. Had she been found by the royal family, she would be in contention for the position of chancellor alongside [url=/c171586]Gris[/url]. Neira is very raw at her Nature Casting, so she never misses out on an opportunity to get help from other Nature Casters that come around. She has been in charge of Lunebrook for the past 6 years and has really helped improve the city.
